This project is funded from federal and state sources through the Knoxville Regional Transportation PlanningOrganization (TPO) Work Program. short_description: Transportation corridor study for Tazewell Pike in Knoxville, Tennessee.

project_scope: Professional services to perform a corridor study for Tazewell Pike (SR-331) along the section from N Broadway (SR-33) to Murphy Road. The assignment concerns transportation engineering and planning and includes corridor-level analysis rather than detailed building or bridge design. Requested disciplines include civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, planning/master planning, environmental engineering/planning/design, traffic design engineering, traffic studies, and transportation planning.
services: Transportation engineering and planning consultancy for a corridor study; likely includes traffic studies, corridor analysis, surveying/GIS, environmental planning, geotechnical input, and conceptual transportation recommendations.

- Pure corridor/urban transportation planning is outside sbp's core target profile.
